source: JRC89037 (2014) 'Eurocode 2: Background & Applications, Design of concrete buildings - worked examples', 3.2.2.3 Punching shear - column B2, pp. 70-75 (R-EC2-JRC-EXAMPLES)

discrepancies.note: The report limits the face stress to v_Rd,max = 0.4 ν f_cd = 3.6 MPa. The UK NA (Amd 1, 2009) 6.4.5(3) gives v_Rd,max = 0.5 ν f_cd = 4.5 MPa, which the workbench uses. The face stress of 2.47 MPa passes under both.

The report computes A_sw = 830 mm² and u_out = 7490 mm from its rounded v_Ed = 1.22 MPa and v_Rd,c = 0.66 MPa. Unrounded (1.2174 and 0.6596 MPa) they are 827 mm² and 7495 mm. The reconciliation uses the report's rounded stresses for these two figures; the workbench computes unrounded.
